glosses.notes: Refers to both the inside and the outside of a place, building, area, or system.

examples.sentence: 修房子的那几天，院子内外一直放着工具，母亲每次带孩子经过的时候，都得先提醒他不要乱碰。
新店开门以后，店里内外都重新收拾过了，连门口那块旧牌子也换成了晚上看得更清楚的新牌子。
学校这次修路以后，校园内外来往的人一下多了不少，所以门口值班的人每天都比以前更早到。

example_translations.translation: During the days when the house was being repaired, tools were left all over the inside and outside of the yard, so every time Mother walked past with the child, she had to remind him not to touch them.
After the new shop opened, the inside and outside were both tidied up again, and even the old sign by the door was replaced with a new one that is easier to read at night.

After the school repaired the road this time, the number of people going back and forth inside and outside the campus suddenly increased a lot, so the person on duty at the gate now arrives earlier every day than before.

glosses.notes: Clothing worn under outer clothes, especially everyday undergarments.

examples.sentence: 姐姐搬家收拾箱子的时候，才发现给孩子买的新内衣一直压在最下面，难怪前几天怎么找都找不到。
天气忽然冷下来以后，母亲把夏天的衣服收起来，又另外准备了几件厚一点的内衣，怕孩子早上出门着凉。
那家店虽然不大，但是卖内衣的阿姨很会看尺寸，姐姐只说了大概情况，她就知道该拿哪一套。

example_translations.translation: While my older sister was packing for her move, she realized that the new underwear she had bought for the child had been pressed all the way to the bottom, which explained why no one could find it over the past few days.

After the weather suddenly turned cold, Mother put away the summer clothes and also prepared several thicker pieces of underwear, worried that the child would get chilled when going out in the morning.
That shop is not big, but the auntie who sells underwear is very good at judging sizes. My sister only described the situation roughly, and the woman already knew which set to take out.

glosses.notes: Can refer to physical energy, strength, or the sense of power someone has left.

examples.sentence: 孩子发了一下午烧，晚上刚吃下几口面，就说自己一点能量都没有了，连坐起来都觉得很费劲。
医生让他恢复的时候别急着跑，说身体刚回来一点能量，如果一下练得太重，第二天更容易难受。
母亲每次加班回来都先喝一大杯热水，再坐下来慢慢吃饭，她说这样人才像真的把能量补回来。

example_translations.translation: The child had a fever all afternoon, and after only a few bites of noodles in the evening, he said he had no energy left at all and that even sitting up felt exhausting.
The doctor told him not to rush into running while recovering, saying that his body had only just regained a little energy and that if he trained too hard at once, he would feel worse the next day.

Every time Mother comes back from working overtime, she first drinks a big cup of hot water and then sits down to eat slowly. She says that only then does it feel as if she is truly getting her energy back.

glosses.notes: Usually refers to usable sources of power, especially when talking about fuel, heating, or electricity.

examples.sentence: 老师讲能源问题的时候，没有先说很远的大事，而是先让我们看家里每天开灯、烧水和做饭到底用了多少。
这座小城过去一直靠老办法供暖，后来换了新的能源设备以后，冬天屋里才慢慢没有以前那么冷。
负责人说，村里以后要不要换这种能源，不是只看价钱高不高，还得看大家用起来是不是方便、安全。

example_translations.translation: When the teacher talked about energy issues, she did not begin with distant big topics. Instead, she first had us look at how much our homes use every day for lights, boiling water, and cooking.
This small city used old methods for heating for a long time, but after it switched to new energy equipment, homes in winter gradually stopped feeling as cold as before.

The person in charge said that whether the village should switch to this kind of energy source in the future does not depend only on whether it is expensive, but also on whether it is convenient and safe for everyone to use.

glosses.notes: Wet earth that sticks easily to shoes, wheels, or clothes.

examples.sentence: 昨晚下过大雨以后，菜地边上的路全成了泥，父亲早上推车进去的时候，鞋底一下就陷住了。
孩子看见河边有一大块湿泥，就忍不住过去踩了几脚，结果回家的时候裤子后面全弄脏了。
工人把门口那堆泥先铲到一边，才让送货的车慢慢倒进来，不然轮子一滑就可能碰到墙。

example_translations.translation: After the heavy rain last night, the road by the vegetable plot had all turned to mud, and when Father pushed the cart in this morning, the soles of his shoes sank in at once.
The child saw a big patch of wet mud by the river and could not resist stepping in it a few times, so by the time he got home the back of his pants was completely dirty.
The workers first shoveled the pile of mud by the entrance to one side before letting the delivery truck back in slowly; otherwise, if a wheel slipped, it could hit the wall.

glosses.notes: Used for yearly plans, summaries, awards, and other things organized by year.

examples.sentence: 公司做年度总结的时候，经理没有只看谁卖得最多，而是先把这一年真正解决过的问题一件一件拿出来讲。
学校把年度活动表贴出来以后，孩子先找的不是放假那几天，而是自己一直盼着参加的那场比赛。
这家杂志每到选年度照片的时候，争得最久的往往不是哪一张最好看，而是哪一张最能留住那年的感觉。

example_translations.translation: When the company did its annual summary, the manager did not look only at who sold the most. He first brought out the problems that had truly been solved over the year and discussed them one by one.
After the school posted the annual activity schedule, the child did not first look for the vacation days, but for the competition he had been looking forward to joining.
Whenever this magazine chooses its annual photo, what people argue over longest is often not which picture looks best, but which one preserves the feeling of that year most strongly.

glosses.notes: Refers to the closing part of the year, especially when work, accounts, or reviews are being wrapped up.

examples.sentence: 年终快到的时候，父亲每天回家都比以前晚一点，因为店里要把账一笔一笔对清楚，不能留到明年再说。
姐姐原来以为年终聚会只是大家吃一顿饭，后来真的去帮忙准备，才发现前前后后有那么多事要顾。
老板说，年终最忙的不是把礼物发下去，而是先弄明白这一年到底哪些人真的帮公司扛住了最难的时候。

example_translations.translation: When year-end approached, Father came home a little later every day than before because the shop had to check the accounts line by line and could not leave them until next year.

My older sister had thought that the year-end gathering was just everyone eating one meal together, but after she actually went to help prepare it, she realized how many things had to be handled from start to finish.
The boss said that at year-end, the busiest part is not handing out the gifts, but first figuring out which people truly helped the company shoulder the hardest moments of the year.

glosses.notes: A colloquial everyday verb for studying or being in school.

examples.sentence: 父亲年轻时在外地念书的时候，最难的不是吃得差，而是每次收到家里的信以后，心里总会更想回去看看。
他虽然一边上班一边念书，但是每天晚上坐到桌前以后，还是先把第二天要用的材料都摆好才放心。
村里那个孩子出去念书好多年了，可是每次放假回来，还是会先去看以前常帮他借书的那位老师。

example_translations.translation: When Father was young and studying away from home, the hardest part was not eating poorly, but that every time he received a letter from home, he wanted even more to go back and visit.
Although he works while studying, every night after sitting down at his desk, he still arranges all the materials he will need the next day before he can relax.
That child from the village has been away studying for many years, but every time he comes back during a break, he still first goes to see the teacher who used to help him borrow books.

glosses.notes: Used for twisting something by hand or body movement, such as a handle, cloth, or joint.

examples.sentence: 门把手太旧了，姐姐早上出门的时候连着扭了好几下都没打开，最后还是父亲过来帮她往上提了一点。
孩子跑得太急，在台阶上脚下一滑，刚把身子扭回来一点，人还是一下坐到了地上。
母亲把湿毛巾轻轻扭干以后，先擦桌上的水，再去看锅里那锅汤是不是已经开了。

example_translations.translation: The doorknob was too old, and when my sister tried to leave in the morning, she twisted it several times without getting it open. In the end Father had to come over and help lift it a little.
The child was running too fast, slipped on the step, and although he managed to twist his body back a little, he still landed on the ground at once.
After Mother gently twisted the wet towel dry, she first wiped up the water on the table and then went to check whether the soup in the pot had already come to a boil.

glosses.notes: Farm-grown goods such as grain, fruit, vegetables, and other products from agricultural work.

examples.sentence: 这次展览把几个地方的农产品放在一起以后，大家才看出来同样是米和豆，做法、颜色和味道能差这么多。
父亲去山里谈生意的时候，最关心的不是农产品卖得贵不贵，而是路一断，后面的货还能不能按时运出去。
那家小店专门卖附近村里的农产品，所以墙上写得很清楚，今天这些菜和果子都是谁家一早送来的。

example_translations.translation: After this exhibition placed agricultural products from several places together, everyone could finally see that even when the goods were all rice and beans, the methods, colors, and flavors could differ this much.

When Father went into the mountains to discuss business, what he cared about most was not whether farm products sold for a high price, but whether the goods behind them could still be shipped out on time if the road was cut off.
That small shop specializes in agricultural products from nearby villages, so the wall says very clearly which families delivered these vegetables and fruits early this morning.

glosses.notes: Describes something full or intense, such as interest, flavor, atmosphere, or color.

examples.sentence: 老街那家书店地方不大，但是一进门就有很浓厚的旧纸味和安静气氛，所以姐姐每次路过都想进去站一会儿。
孩子最近对天文的兴趣越来越浓厚，晚上只要天一黑，他就抱着那本书跑到院子里找星星。
这场小型演出虽然没有大舞台，但是现场的节日味很浓厚，连坐在后面的老人都一直笑着跟着拍手。

example_translations.translation: The bookstore on the old street is not large, but the moment you walk in, there is a strong smell of old paper and a quiet atmosphere, so my sister wants to step inside every time she passes by.
The child’s interest in astronomy has been growing more and more intense lately. As soon as it gets dark at night, he grabs that book and runs into the yard to look for stars.
Although this small performance had no big stage, the festive feeling on site was very rich, and even the elderly people sitting in the back kept smiling and clapping along.

glosses.notes: Land used for growing crops.

examples.sentence: 火车开到这边以后，窗外连着好几片农田都还带着水，远远看过去，像把整片天都照在地上了。
村里决定修那条新路的时候，最先担心的不是工期，而是路要是改得不好，会不会把前面那片农田切得太碎。
昨晚的大风过去以后，父亲一早就去看农田，因为他怕刚长出来的苗让水压住，后面补起来更麻烦。

example_translations.translation: After the train reached this area, several stretches of farmland outside the window were still covered with water, and from far away it looked as if the whole sky were reflected on the ground.
When the village decided to build that new road, the first concern was not the construction schedule, but whether a poor redesign would cut the farmland in front into pieces that were too broken up.

After last night’s strong wind passed, Father went to check the farmland first thing in the morning because he was afraid the newly sprouted seedlings had been pressed down by water and would be harder to save later.

glosses.notes: Can describe warmth itself or the act of making something warmer.

examples.sentence: 太阳出来以后，屋里慢慢暖起来了，母亲才把一直盖在孩子腿上的小毯子轻轻拿开了一点。
这碗汤刚端上来的时候还不够暖，姐姐怕老人喝了胃里难受，又放回厨房里重新热了一下。
外面风还很大，但是车门一关上，车里立刻就暖多了，所以孩子刚坐稳就靠着窗睡着了。

example_translations.translation: After the sun came out, the room slowly warmed up, and only then did Mother gently pull back the small blanket that had been covering the child’s legs.

When the bowl of soup was first brought out, it still was not warm enough. My sister worried that the older person’s stomach would feel uncomfortable, so she took it back to the kitchen to heat it again.
The wind outside was still strong, but as soon as the car door shut, it felt much warmer inside, so the child leaned against the window and fell asleep as soon as he settled down.

glosses.notes: Usually refers to indoor heating or heating equipment, especially in winter.

examples.sentence: 北方的冬天一来，家里要是没有暖气，孩子早上从被子里出来到洗脸那几分钟就最难受。
办公室这两天暖气开得太足，姐姐坐了一上午以后，连手边那杯热茶都一直没顾上喝。
房东来修暖气的时候，先让我们把窗边的桌子挪开，因为那根旧管子一动，后面可能会掉下不少灰。

example_translations.translation: Once winter arrives in the north, if a home has no heating, the hardest few minutes for a child are the stretch from climbing out of bed to washing up in the morning.
The heating in the office has been turned up too high these past two days, and after sitting there all morning, my sister had not even found time to drink the cup of hot tea by her hand.
When the landlord came to repair the heater, he first had us move the table by the window away because once that old pipe started moving, a lot of dust might fall afterward.

glosses.notes: Someone admired deeply and treated as a model worth following.

examples.sentence: 孩子原来把那位球员当成偶像，可是真正见到他训练以后，最佩服的反而不是成绩，而是每天都那么认真。
姐姐说，小时候喜欢一个偶像很正常，可是要是只会跟着喊名字，却不知道人家为什么值得学，那就太可惜了。
那场分享会结束以后，母亲发现女儿口中的偶像并不是最会说话的人，而是那个一直安静做事、最后把问题解决的人。

example_translations.translation: The child used to treat that player as an idol, but after actually seeing him train, what he admired most was not the results, but how serious he was every single day.
My sister said that liking an idol when you are young is perfectly normal, but if all you can do is shout the person’s name without knowing why they are worth learning from, that is a real pity.
After that sharing event ended, Mother realized that the person her daughter called an idol was not the one who spoke best, but the one who kept working quietly and finally solved the problem.

glosses.notes: Used for ruling out a possibility, person, or factor after checking.

examples.sentence: 医生先排除了最危险的那几种情况，才让家里人别太紧张，不过还是要把后面几天的变化都记下来。
负责人没有一开始就排除年轻人的意见，因为他知道有些老问题正是外面的人一眼就能看出来的。
要把这件事查清楚，不能只靠感觉排除谁没问题，还得把当天谁来过、谁拿过钥匙都问清楚。

example_translations.translation: The doctor first ruled out the most dangerous possibilities before telling the family not to be too nervous, though the changes over the next few days still needed to be recorded.
The person in charge did not exclude the younger people’s opinions at the very beginning, because he knew that some old problems are exactly the kind that outsiders can spot at a glance.
To investigate this matter clearly, you cannot rely only on instinct to exclude who seems uninvolved. You also have to ask carefully who came that day and who handled the key.

glosses.notes: Used for releasing smoke, gas, waste water, or similar substances.

examples.sentence: 这家工厂去年换了新设备以后，夜里排放出来的烟明显少了，所以住在附近的人开窗的时候也没有以前那么呛。
老师讲汽车排放的时候，没有先说书上的数字，而是先带我们站到路口，看早晚高峰的空气到底有什么不同。
负责人说，这条河这几年能慢慢清下来，一个重要原因就是上游那几家厂终于把排放控制住了。

example_translations.translation: After this factory replaced its equipment last year, the smoke it emitted at night became noticeably less, so people living nearby no longer felt the same choking irritation when opening their windows.

When the teacher talked about vehicle emissions, she did not start with the numbers in the book, but first took us to stand at an intersection and look at what was different about the air during morning and evening rush hour.
The person in charge said that one important reason this river has gradually become cleaner over the past few years is that the factories upstream finally brought their discharges under control.

glosses.notes: To practice a performance, speech, or sequence before the real event.

examples.sentence: 这场演出虽然只有半小时，但是大家为了排练那几个转身和进场顺序，前前后后还是用了整整两个星期。
孩子第一次参加合唱排练的时候，紧张得连开口的时间都记不住，后来还是旁边那个同学一直小声提醒他。
老师说明天正式上台以前，还要按灯光和音乐再排练一遍，因为今天下午有人一转身就走错了方向。

example_translations.translation: Although the performance itself lasts only half an hour, everyone still spent a full two weeks rehearsing those few turns and entrance cues from beginning to end.
The first time the child joined choir rehearsal, he was so nervous that he could not even remember when to start singing, and in the end the classmate beside him kept reminding him in a low voice.

The teacher said that before going on stage for real tomorrow, they still needed to rehearse once more with the lights and music, because someone turned around this afternoon and immediately walked the wrong way.

glosses.notes: Used for arranging people or results by score, performance, or position.

examples.sentence: 这次考试以后，老师没有急着按分数给大家排名，而是先把最容易反复出错的地方一题一题讲清楚。
经理说，店里以后不会只看谁卖得多来排名，因为真正能留住客人的，往往是那些最会解决问题的人。
系统每天都会根据完成情况自动排名，可是父亲更在意的不是自己排第几，而是有没有把答应的事按时做完。

example_translations.translation: After this exam, the teacher did not rush to rank everyone by score, but first explained the places where students were most likely to keep making mistakes, one question at a time.
The manager said that the shop would no longer rank people only by who sold more, because the people who truly keep customers are often the ones best at solving problems.
The system ranks people automatically every day based on how much they complete, but what Father cares about more is not what place he is in, but whether he has finished what he promised on time.

glosses.notes: A common measure word for platefuls, dishes, coils, or trays; this row focuses on the dish-serving use.

examples.sentence: 母亲怕客人来得晚菜会凉，所以那盘刚炒好的鱼一直没有先端上桌，只等大家坐齐再说。
孩子本来只想尝一口，结果那盘切好的西瓜一放到桌上，他就坐在旁边一边说话一边吃了大半。
老板看见厨房里还剩一盘没卖完的点心，就让店员先别急着收起来，说晚上也许还有人来买茶。

example_translations.translation: Mother was afraid the food would get cold if the guests arrived late, so that plate of freshly fried fish was not brought to the table right away and was left waiting until everyone had sat down.
The child had meant to try only one bite, but once that plate of sliced watermelon was placed on the table, he sat beside it talking and eating until most of it was gone.
When the boss saw that there was still one plate of pastries left unsold in the kitchen, he told the clerk not to put it away yet, saying that someone might still come later for tea.

glosses.notes: Expresses a strong hopeful wish for something someone has been waiting for.

examples.sentence: 奶奶一直盼望着老房子门前那棵树再发一次新芽，因为只要它还活着，她就觉得家没有真的变远。
那个在外地念书的孩子最盼望的，不是放假以后天天睡到很晚，而是终于能坐下来陪父亲好好吃几顿饭。
大家忙了这么久，其实都在盼望一个简单的结果，就是等门一打开，里面的问题已经真被解决了。

example_translations.translation: Grandmother has always longed to see the tree in front of the old house put out new buds once again, because as long as it is still alive, she feels home has not truly grown far away.
What that child studying away from home looks forward to most is not sleeping late every day during the vacation, but finally sitting down and eating a few good meals with his father.
After everyone has been busy for so long, what they are really longing for is one simple outcome: that once the door opens, the problem inside has truly already been solved.

glosses.notes: Describes something enormous in size, scale, amount, or complexity.

examples.sentence: 第一次看见医院后面那套庞大的系统时，姐姐才明白为什么一个小小的错误，前前后后会让那么多人一起忙起来。
村里原来只有几辆车的时候还好管，可是后来人一多、路一多，那套旧办法面对庞大的交通量就明显不够了。
父亲说，这家公司最难的不是地方不够大，而是资料实在太庞大，光把旧箱子里的东西重新分好就用了半个月。

example_translations.translation: The first time my sister saw the huge system behind the hospital, she finally understood why one tiny mistake could set so many people busy from beginning to end.
When the village had only a few vehicles, things were still easy to manage, but once there were more people and more roads, the old method was clearly not enough for such a huge traffic volume.

Father said that the hardest thing for this company is not that the space is too small, but that the materials are simply too enormous; just sorting everything in the old boxes again took half a month.

glosses.notes: To toss or cast something away, upward, or toward another place.

examples.sentence: 孩子刚学会接球的时候，总爱把球抛得太高，结果别人还没准备好，他自己先吓得往后退了两步。
姐姐把旧衣服一件一件看完以后，才舍得把真正没用的几件抛进纸箱，因为她怕里面还有能穿的。
风一大起来，工地上的人就不敢随便把绳子抛过去了，怕另一头没接稳，东西反而掉到下面伤到人。

example_translations.translation: When the child had just learned to catch a ball, he always liked to throw it too high. The result was that before anyone else was ready, he himself had already jumped back in fright.

Only after my sister looked through the old clothes one by one did she feel willing to throw the truly useless pieces into the cardboard box, because she was afraid there might still be some worth wearing.

As soon as the wind grew strong, the people at the work site no longer dared toss the rope over casually, afraid that the other end would not be caught firmly and the item would fall below and hurt someone.

glosses.notes: Can refer to a bubble of liquid or foam, and also to steeping or soaking something in water.

examples.sentence: 孩子把吸管放进杯子里轻轻一吹，牛奶上那些小泡马上越堆越高，差一点儿就流到了桌上。
母亲每天晚上都会先把花茶泡上，再坐下来慢慢看今天记下来的事，她说这样心里比较容易静下来。
走了一天以后，父亲回家先接了一盆热水泡脚，等身上那股冷气慢慢散了，才觉得人真正轻松下来。

example_translations.translation: The child put a straw into the cup and blew gently, and the little bubbles on top of the milk immediately piled higher and higher until they almost spilled onto the table.
Every evening, Mother first steeps the flower tea before sitting down to look slowly through the things she wrote down that day. She says that helps her mind settle more easily.
After walking all day, Father first filled a basin with hot water to soak his feet, and only after the chill slowly left his body did he feel truly relaxed.

glosses.notes: To make up for loss or damage, especially through payment or another agreed remedy.

examples.sentence: 店里那块玻璃是送货的人倒车时碰碎的，所以老板没有先发火，而是先把怎么赔偿谈清楚再让大家继续干活。
合同里把赔偿办法写得很细，就是怕真出了问题以后，双方一着急，只记得争谁对谁错，却忘了先解决损失。
孩子把邻居借来的玩具弄坏以后，父亲没有只说一句对不起就算了，而是带着他一起上门谈赔偿和修理。

example_translations.translation: The glass in the shop was broken when the delivery worker backed up and hit it, so the boss did not lose his temper first. Instead, he made sure how the compensation would work before letting everyone keep working.

The contract spells out the compensation method in great detail because it is afraid that once a real problem happens, both sides will panic, remember only to argue about who is right and wrong, and forget to deal with the loss first.
After the child broke a toy borrowed from the neighbor, Father did not think that one apology was enough. He took him over in person to talk about compensation and repair.
